title: Storybook world map

steps.name: v2-nanobanana
steps.prompt:
A hand-drawn map in the style of a classic 1920s children's storybook endpaper map, drawn by a book illustrator: loose, delicate, scratchy fine pen-and-ink lines, very light and sketchy, with sparing soft watercolour washes (pale sage greens, faded blues, a little ochre) on lots of warm, slightly mottled cream paper. Not polished, not digital, not vector: it should look like an original ink-and-watercolour drawing in an old book, with the charm of a child's imagined country. Trees drawn as hundreds of tiny scribbled round crowns, paths as wobbly dashed lines, small sketchy buildings seen at a slant, a whimsical little hand-drawn compass with a curly N, a simple hand-ruled double-line border. Labels hand-lettered in a charming, slightly wobbly childlike hand, few and clearly spelled.

Layout (landscape, west on the left, east on the right):
- Centre-left: a small home wood of scribbled trees. In it a tall, thin, crooked old house with an attic window (label "Attic"). Beside it a dark, still round pond hatched in deep ink (label "Black Pond"); many little dashed paths radiate from the pond to every other place. On the pond's shore a tiny empty railway station with a short stub of track that goes nowhere (label "Station"). In tiny writing by the pond: "something listens beneath".
- Top-left: a lonely forest of many tiny trees with a little cottage and curling chimney smoke (label "Lonely Forest").
- Left edge: a small clearing with a badger's sett (label "Badger").
- Bottom-left: a little archive house with a tea garden and a tiny wooden jetty with a signal lamp on the water.
- Upper middle: a wide winding river, and in it, half hidden in soft grey watercolour mist, a tiny island of willow bushes (label "Willows").
- Right half: a wide sea washed in deep wine-purple (label "Wine-Dark Sea") with a tiny sailing ship and little curly waves. On the far right a large rugged Greek land of hills and olive trees with tiny temples and walled towns: a walled city with a gate (label "Thebes"), a hill crowned by a temple (label "Athens"), a mountain shrine, a small harbour, a dark cave mouth in a hillside. A tiny far-off walled town on a distant shore, and tiny pyramids at the bottom-right edge.
- Soft unlabelled mist drifting over the corners, a curly "here be mists" in the top-right corner.

Only these words appear, each spelled exactly: "Attic", "Black Pond", "Station", "Lonely Forest", "Badger", "Willows", "Wine-Dark Sea", "Thebes", "Athens", "something listens beneath", "here be mists", and N on the compass. No other text, no title.

steps.name: v5-edit-nanobanana
steps.prompt:
Edit this hand-drawn storybook map. Keep the drawing, composition, colours, line style and every other label exactly as they are. Make only these text changes, in the same hand-lettered style:
1. Erase the words "little quirky archive house" completely (fill with plain cream paper) and write "Hoppy Cat" in their place under the cottage.
2. Erase the words "tea garden" completely, leaving plain cream paper.
3. Erase the words "mountain shrine" completely, leaving the little shrine drawing unlabelled.
4. Erase the words "home wood" completely, leaving the trees.
5. Add the word "Troy" in the same hand-lettered style just beneath the small walled town at the top right edge.
No other changes; no new text.

note: The original generated PNGs are represented by their hashes.
